ui.title: Adventure pilot
ui.notice: Progress is not saved automatically. Use Menu → Export save to keep it, and Import save to continue later.
ui.help: Click or tap the floor to walk. Click or tap a person or object to open the action ring, then choose an action. Click an inventory item to carry it, then click what to use it on. Right-click or Esc cancels. Click to skip a line.
ui.confirmNew: Start a new game? Unexported progress will be lost.
ui.confirmImport: Replace the current game with this save? Unexported progress will be lost.
ui.rotate: Turn your device sideways to play.
save.error.tooLarge: That file is too large to be a save.
save.error.notJson: That file is not a readable save.
save.error.notSave: That file is not a save for this game.
save.error.version: That save comes from an unsupported version.
save.error.invalid: That save is damaged or was edited incorrectly. Your current game was kept.
line.heroUseItem: I'd rather keep it in my pocket.
line.heroTalk: Talking to myself again? Not in public.
line.heroLie: Very convincing. Nobody will suspect a thing.
line.keyNotSuitcase: The key is far too big for that little lock.
line.suitcaseLookClosed: An old leather suitcase. Someone left it behind.
line.suitcaseLookEmpty: Nothing left in it but the red lining.
line.suitcaseLookKey: There's a brass key lying on the lining.
line.suitcaseTake: It weighs a ton. I'll leave it here.
line.keyLook: A heavy brass key. It looks like it belongs to a door.
line.keyUseInPlace: I should pick it up first.
line.doorUnlocked: Click! The lock gives way. The key stays in the lock.
line.doorLookOpen: The door is open. I can see the street.
line.doorLookLocked: A sturdy door with a serious-looking lock.
line.doorNeedsKey: I need something to use on that lock.
line.doorClosedGo: I'd have to open it first.
line.windowLook: Blue sky outside. A good day to leave this hall.
line.paintingLook: Mountains at sunset. The signature reads "anon."
line.paintingTake: It's screwed to the wall. Someone's clearly been here before.
line.lampLook: A little lamp on a little table.
line.lampUse: The bulb is dead. Like the atmosphere in here.
line.hotelDoorKey: That doorway has no door to lock.
line.hotelDoorLook: The way back into the hotel hall.
line.hotelDoorClose: There's no door to close, just a doorway.
line.signLook: The paint has faded too much to read.
line.lampPostLook: A cast-iron street lamp. Still lit in daylight.
line.buildingsLook: Tall houses with tidy windows. Nobody looks out.
line.buildingsOpen: I'm not breaking into anyone's house.
line.keeperItem: Keep it, keep it. I have keys enough for a lifetime.
line.keeperLook: An old man in a green coat. He looks like he knows this street.
line.keeperLookDead: He's lying very, very still. Suspiciously still.
line.askCrouch: Could you crouch down for me?
dlg.keeper.first1: Well, well. Someone finally came out of that old hotel.
dlg.choice.key: I found a key in a suitcase.
dlg.keeper.who1: I keep an eye on this street. Have done for forty years.
dlg.keeper.who2: Nobody pays me, mind you. It's a calling.
dlg.keeper.whoAgain: The keeper of the street. Forty years, remember?
dlg.keeper.place2: Too quiet, if you ask me.
dlg.keeper.key1: A suitcase in the hotel hall? Nobody has stayed there in years.
dlg.keeper.key3: Then keep your eyes open, traveller. This street has more doors.
